title: MTSF Progressive Graph
purpose: Materializes T1 assertion store with substrate anchors and T2 content graph with adjacency indexes. Provides follow/expand traversal for semantic, provenance, structural, and temporal modes.

artifacts.name: assertion_store
artifacts.purpose: T1 typed assertions, evidence bundles, event anchors

artifacts.name: content_graph
artifacts.purpose: T2 compressed nodes and semantic/provenance/structural adjacency

artifacts.name: global_content_graph
artifacts.purpose: Global merged content graph across promoted sessions

artifacts.name: graph_events
artifacts.purpose: Append-only Layer 4 graph promotion and rebuild events

cli_commands: python tools/conversation_os.py mtsf graph-follow --session-id ... --start entity-id --mode semantic --depth 1
python tools/conversation_os.py mtsf graph-follow --scope global --start session-id::entity-id --mode alias
python tools/conversation_os.py mtsf graph-expand --session-id ... --node-id entity-id --facets identity,evidence,substrate
python tools/conversation_os.py mtsf graph-expand --scope global --node-id session-id::entity-id --facets identity,evidence
when_to_use: When auditing provenance or walking entity neighborhoods
do_not: Inline evidence spans in content_graph nodes
Edit assertion_store by hand without re-ingest
